source_notes: Re-verified: formerly Driftwood LNG; Woodside took FID on the 16.5 mtpa foundational Phase 1 in April 2025 (Bechtel lump-sum EPC). source_notes: Re-verified: Magnolia LNG (Glenfarne) remains proposed/pre-FID, 8.8 mtpa, FERC-permitted with FTA+non-FTA DOE authorizations; sought further FERC schedule extension. No FID announced. Owner Magnolia LNG LLC / parent Glenfarne Group unchanged.

Re-verified: Gulfstream LNG (Plaquemines Parish; up to ~4 mtpa, 3 trains) proposed; FERC accepted the application into Certificate Proceeding (Docket CP25-519-000) on 21 Jul 2025. Construction targeted mid-2027, first LNG ~Jan 2030 - consistent with GEM ConstructionYear 2027 / start 2029-2030. GEM capacity 4.2 mtpa vs FERC 'up to 4 mtpa' (within rounding/optimization range, left unchanged).
